Q00607

40. INSTALL TRANSMISSION HOUSING
(a) Clean the threads of the bolts and case with white gasoline.
(b) Apply seal packing or equivalent to the six bolts.
Seal packing:
Part No. 08826-00070, THREE BOND 1324 or equivalent
(c) Install and torque the 6 bolts.
Torque:
10 mm bolt  34 N·m (345 kgf·cm, 25 ft·lbf)
12 mm bolt  57 N·m (580 kgf·cm, 42 ft·lbf)

AT6647

41. INSTALL NO.2 VEHICLE SPEED SENSOR
(a) Install the O-ring from the sensor.
(b) Install the No.2 vehicle speed sensor.

Q00620

42. INSTALL NO.1 VEHICLE SPEED SENSOR
(a) Install the O-ring from the sensor.
(b) Install the No.1 vehicle speed sensor.
